description: This course provides hands-on experience with neural networks, covering topics such as supervised learning with backpropagation algorithms; deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch; neural network architectures including CNNs and RNNs; activation functions such as ReLU and sigmoid; optimization techniques like stochastic gradient descent and Adam; and standard datasets such as MNIST and CIFAR-10. Students will also explore neural network training pipelines, hyperparameter tuning, and model evaluation metrics such as accuracy and F1-score.

clos.text: Define the architecture and components of a basic neural network, including input, hidden, and output layers.
Describe the mathematical foundations of backpropagation and gradient descent optimization techniques.
Explain the working principles of convolutional and recurrent neural networks, including their applications in image and sequence data.
Apply deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch to implement and train neural network models.
Evaluate the performance of neural networks using standard evaluation metrics and techniques for hyperparameter tuning.

labs: Implement a basic neural network using TensorFlow
Implement a basic neural network using PyTorch
Implement a CNN for image classification using CIFAR-10 dataset
Implement an RNN for sequence prediction using MNIST dataset
Tune hyperparameters for a neural network model using K-fold cross-validation
Evaluate model performance using precision, recall, and F1-score metrics
Implement a CNN using pre-trained models for transfer learning
Implement an LSTM network for time series prediction
Build a complete training pipeline for a deep learning model
Develop and present a final project using neural networks
